laws.rule: Contamines-Montjoie national nature reserve (Haute-Savoie, near Mont Blanc): from 15 June to 15 September, bivouac (sleeping out, with or without a tent) is prohibited in the zones marked red on the order's map, which cover everything below 2,500 metres and sensitive areas. It is tolerated from 19:00 to 09:00 on two marked sites (Pont de la Rollaz, 40 tents; La Balme, 50 tents) and outside the red zones. Arrêté DDT-2026-0474 of the Haute-Savoie prefect, valid to 31 December 2026.
laws.heading: Arrêté DDT-2026-0474, art 1

laws.rule: In the same reserve, swimming and boating on the lakes and ponds are prohibited all year, including pets swimming, dogs in particular. Arrêté DDT-2026-0474, art 2; the prefect can grant exemptions for research or other justified reasons.
laws.heading: Arrêté DDT-2026-0474, art 2
